story.hiv_2_bifrost.after:
We are integrating the assets of Dilthey into our structure. Some of their stations and transport chains have gone to the Unchained Belt, as if they were prepared for the corporation to fall. This is acceptable.

The technology for passage between physical reality and bramfaturic space has been transferred to HIS Magnum. Dr. Eipschwitz will receive access to the data. Yes, we know he is still with you. He will add the Phase Bomb to your fabricator recipes. You must find a way to use this technology to serve the Hive more efficiently. Dilthey wanted to build a bridge to escape the human cradle. We will use that bridge differently. The awakening of the Hive will require not an engineer's dream, but a tool that works.
story.hiv_2_bifrost.briefing: Looks like we really are heading into an army of clones. There are a lot of biosignatures, and they are not moving like civilians. Tight groups, corridors covered, no panic. So much for the pleasant tour of an engineering marvel. Be careful.
story.hiv_2_bifrost.details:
Details: Officially, Dilthey turned Geist into an engineering center and a platform for further expansion. AnCom report that the reality is much darker. Geist's mass and orbital architecture were selected and arranged to attract the bramfatura known as Skrivnus. Sergei King, Managing Director of Dilthey, bears direct responsibility for this project. The corporation is making a deliberate attempt to study and control the very force that provokes catastrophe. We must expose their hidden agenda to the entire Solar System. We will drop you into Vasa's residential zone. You will have to fight your way through it into the corporate headquarters. Find Sergei King there and eliminate him.

Additional Info: There is something about clones and Dilthey that we should know before the operation begins. Normally, clones are too expensive to do ordinary labor. Printing an adult body, integrating a personality and a training program into it—all of that only makes sense when the return is worth the cost. Corporations handed this technology over to PMCs so they would always have a field instrument for testing new weapons, armor, drugs, or even hypotheses. The only exception is Tianming. But the data on Dilthey does not fit that economy either. The Hive gave us a data stream to cross-check, and it indicates that there is a classified cloning station somewhere inside Geist. Judging by the number of biosignatures on the service levels, they may have an entire clone army in there. Be ready for that.
story.hiv_2_bifrost.dlg.stage1_hive_elev: This elevator leads to <color=#FFFEC1>Dilthey</color> headquarters. Go up in it. <color=#FFFEC1>Sergei King</color> should be there. Find him and carry out the execution.
story.hiv_2_bifrost.dlg.stage1_hive_thre: We really did think Dilthey were using clones. But these are not clones. The psychological profiles and weapon signatures match <color=#FFFEC1>Unchained Belt</color> combat groups. Now we understand why the Main Belt never broke into open war against the Hexarchy. <color=#FFFEC1>Dilthey</color> really did make a secret alliance with the pirates and called them in to protect <color=#FFFEC1>Sergei King</color>. Continue the operation. We will publish this information for everyone to see.
story.hiv_2_bifrost.dlg.stage2_hive_comp: The main <color=#FFFEC1>Dilthey</color> computer is right in front of you. Connect to it. We need <color=#FFFEC1>Sergei King</color>'s personal tag. If he's still aboard <color=#FFFEC1>Vasa</color>, the station itself will show us where its architect is hiding.

We have unlocked the elevator to the third level. <color=#FFFEC1>King</color> should be there. We should warn you: this level does not appear on any Vasa floor plan. Dilthey have been hiding an entire sector inside <color=#FFFEC1>Geist</color>. Go up there. We need to understand what they built.
story.hiv_2_bifrost.dlg.stage2_jane_gree: According to the bioscanners, there is less security here than there should be. And naturally, I don't like that. Either they have pulled back from their positions, or they're guarding something else. Find the main <color=#FFFEC1>Dilthey</color> computer. If we can get into the station's internal data, I'll try to pick up <color=#FFFEC1>King</color>'s personal tag and figure out where he is now.
story.hiv_2_bifrost.dlg.stage2_sergey_co: How predictable. Idiots who willingly work for the <color=#FFFEC1>Hive</color> will do everything obediently and without asking questions.
story.hiv_2_bifrost.dlg.stage3_hive_serg: <color=#FFFEC1>Sergei King</color> has been eliminated. We are not ready to recall the contract. Go into the bramfatura. This passage leads there. If <color=#FFFEC1>Dilthey</color> really did build a colony inside <color=#FFFEC1>Skrivnus</color>, we need to see what it looks like.
story.hiv_2_bifrost.dlg.stage3_sergey_gr: Welcome to the place where your masters stop understanding what is happening. Do not be afraid to look down. I have always known how to build bridges over an abyss.
story.hiv_2_bifrost.dlg.stage3_sergey_po: Before you stands <color=#FFFEC1>Bifrost</color>. The first true bridge out of the human cradle, leading to a place where humanity will no longer be bound by gravity and the second law of thermodynamics. A bridge from prison to freedom.
story.hiv_2_bifrost.dlg.stage4_hive_gree: Telefaturic Dislocation confirmed. You are no longer inside Geist. This is <color=#FFFEC1>Skrivnus</color>. And Dilthey really did build a colony here. Move deeper and take a closer look.
story.hiv_2_bifrost.dlg.stage4_hive_serg: That is enough. We have confirmed that Dilthey were trying to make their own leadership reproducible, while having no moral difficulty sending people to survive in Skrivnus. Return to the extraction point. Your further presence inside the bramfatura is not advisable.
story.hiv_2_bifrost.dlg.stage4_sergey_3_: Surprise, clone. The contract is not over. I'm alive. Look around you. This is not a bramfatura invading the human world. This is the first human settlement on the other side. My corporation and I did what every other Hexarch considered madness. I'm the only one who didn't hide from the future. I started building it.
story.hiv_2_bifrost.dlg.stage4_sergey_se: The Hexarchy has treated clones as expendable assets for far too long. If a personality can be printed, why should only soldiers be printed?

story.hiv_2_rokosz.after: RealWare's chain of command has collapsed, the combat AI has been isolated, the nuclear arsenals have been locked down, and the corporation's main force assets are coming under our control. Humanity remains vulnerable until the transition is complete. We have reduced the number of future catastrophes. Now we must complete the transformation of the System.
story.hiv_2_rokosz.briefing: How are you doing in there? Got your knees over your ears to keep the draft out? I hope you can hear me through that tin can. The Hive reports that the site is empty. No guards, in order not to draw attention to it. Find the dish pointed into space. There should be an unremarkable switch nearby. Flip it, the Hive will seize control, and we will pull you back to the Magnum before the attack on Ares.
story.hiv_2_rokosz.details:
Details: Formally, RealWare remains the force pillar of the AnCap system. In reality, it is the last corporation capable of turning the current crisis into total war and derailing the plan to save humanity. As long as Ian Fraser and Angus Dungeon retain control of the HIS Ares, RealWare retains access to the nuclear legacy of the old world and enough loyal forces to declare everything happening in the Solar System a rebellion against the NCE. The Hive reports that the time for negotiations is over. It is time to begin direct combat operations against those for whom war has always been a trade. The contractor will be delivered to the surface of Mars in a capsule with a reduced radar and scanner profile. There is a secret radar station there, through which RealWare coordinates the combat AI aboard the Ares. If the Hive gains access to that station, it will be able to intercept, distort, and replace signals inside the ship's command network. After that, a direct assault on Ares will become possible.

Additional Info: A direct strike is doomed. First, the shuttle will simply be shot down on approach to Ares. Second, RealWare will have time to authorize nuclear strikes against Hive headquarters and the Magnum. Third, according to the data we have received, Dungeon's heartbeat is tied to an automatic missile launch against the key stations of every major corporation. Even a successful lightning assault could start a chain reaction, so the operation must begin not with Ares, but with taking control away from it.
story.hiv_2_rokosz.dlg.angus_1: Who let that cockroach aboard? Magnum, attention: this is a rokosz against the NCE and the AnCap system. When I melt this cloned meat, I am coming for you personally, mercenary.
story.hiv_2_rokosz.dlg.angus_2: Come on, clone. Do what they pulled you out of the jar to do. Just remember: if my heart stops, the end comes for the entire Solar System.
story.hiv_2_rokosz.dlg.angus_3: Congratulations, you have just launched missiles at every targ… What? So they got deeper than I thought. Fine. That leaves good old-fashioned soldiering. Stand to the end and kill the ones who came from them, from out there, to us in here.
story.hiv_2_rokosz.dlg.frazer_1: So. The Hive, is it? Curious. AnCom began as a clandestine network studying quasimorphosis, and ends up as a monster that needs a courier with a gun. You do not understand what you are protecting, clone.
story.hiv_2_rokosz.dlg.frazer_2: Why did the missiles not launch? No, impossible. How did they intercept the signal? The Sixth Hexarch guaranteed that...
story.hiv_2_rokosz.dlg.hive_1: Contact established. In the informational sense, the HIS Ares no longer belongs to RealWare. Their combat AI is resisting with everything it has, but calming it down will be a pleasant chore. Return to the capsule so we can pull you back to the Magnum. We need to prepare for the attack.
story.hiv_2_rokosz.dlg.hive_2: Warning: RealWare has intercepted your biosignature in this sector. A strike team is heading your way. They do not know whether you are an escaped critter from Intercity or one of our saboteurs, but they will shoot to kill either way. Fight your way back to the capsule.
story.hiv_2_rokosz.dlg.hive_3: Threat on the Magnum eliminated? Excellent. There is no more time to recover, rearm, or prepare. Coordinated action by RealWare's leadership and combat AI could restore control over the HIS Ares firmware. The intercept is already unstable and continuing to destabilize. The printed clone is operational, and the shuttle is ready. Proceed to Ares immediately and finish the operation.
story.hiv_2_rokosz.dlg.hive_4: Landing confirmed. We are continuing to block the combat AI’s commands, but RealWare is already taking Ares back. Find and eliminate Angus Dungeon and Ian Fraser. Without them, the spacecraft will remain masterless hardware, and we will take it for ourselves.
story.hiv_2_rokosz.dlg.hive_5: Contract fulfillment confirmed. Anomalous behavior has been detected in RealWare's combat AI: it is displaying independence while its autonomy module is disabled. Apparently, RealWare was preparing for combat operations against the Solar System and upgraded it accordingly. That means we arrived in time.
story.hiv_2_rokosz.dlg.jane_1: Don't look at the capsule like that. It won't get any more comfortable. Climb inside and strap in. See you on the Magnum.
story.hiv_2_rokosz.dlg.jane_2: Welcome back. I would meet you in person, but we have a small adjustment to the plan. While you were climbing up from Mars, RealWare sent an assault group to the Magnum. They are already in the hangar, and they seem very eager to discuss your illegal visit to a secret facility. So first, clear the hangar.
story.hiv_2_rokosz.dlg.jane_3: We did the impossible. Now we have to do the second impossible thing: get out alive. Evacuation authorized.
story.hiv_2_rokosz.name: Rokosz
story.hiv_2_rokosz.objective.find_termin: Find and switch the control terminal.
story.hiv_2_rokosz.objective.kill_bosses: Eliminate Angus Dungeon and Ian Fraser.
story.hiv_2_rokosz.objective.repel_realw: Eliminate RealWare Security in the Magnum hangar.

story.hiv_2_telegraph.after: <color=#FFFEC1>SBN</color> has been integrated into the Hive. We have announced the quasimorphic threat across the Solar System. The Ark cannot be built with closed eyes. The work is not finished. Operations to stabilize the System and complete the awakening must continue. Humanity must become something worthy of salvation before the Sun becomes fit for the birth of Gagtungr.
story.hiv_2_telegraph.briefing: The station is going into full isolation. The Hive cannot begin synchronization while the <color=#FFFEC1>Jamming Nodes</color> are active. There are three of them, all on the Landing Level. Find each one, blow it to hell, and only then take the elevator up.
story.hiv_2_telegraph.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Destroy the Jamming Nodes, destroy the Engram Servers, and install the Hellstrom Index in the station’s control computer.
story.hiv_2_telegraph.details:
Details: Formally, SBN remains the System’s information infrastructure and the maintainer of the servers holding the current version of the NCE. In reality, it is the last network concealing the full truth about quasimorphosis, bramfaturas, and the true scale of the current crisis from the Solar System. The time has come for the Hive to integrate this network, gain access to every human being's attention, and open humanity's eyes to the necessity of building the Ark. The operation will proceed in several stages. On the first level, destroy the special Jamming Nodes protecting the facility from external signals. Then the operative must proceed to the second level and disable three Engram Control Servers. These servers keep SBN’s command circuits isolated. The second level also contains transport airlocks. Find a suitable airlock and receive the capsule carrying the Hellstrom Index. The Hive will not transmit the Index directly to the Magnum. Its level of trust in us remains limited. The operative must extract the Index from the capsule personally. After that, the final stage of the operation begins. Proceed to the third level and place the Hellstrom Index into SBN's Control Computer.

Additional Info: The Hellstrom Index is an installation medium capable of instantly integrating a distributed network into the Hive. The difficulty is that SBN's CEO and COO are connected to their own infrastructure through specialized neurointerfaces and control data routing directly, in real time. Roberto Millner may be eliminated. His functions are duplicated and can be easily replaced by the Hive. Ally Pally must survive. After a series of brain modifications that left intact the striking, expressive appearance that SBN had turned into one of its chief public assets, she became a living relay tower. If the Hive integrates Pally, the subjugation of all SBN will become a simple technical procedure.
story.hiv_2_telegraph.dlg.stage1_hive_gr: We'll patch into the station step by step as you advance. Start with the jamming towers.
story.hiv_2_telegraph.dlg.stage1_hive_ja: The first <color=#FFFEC1>Jamming Node</color> is down. Bringing the satellite into position over the station.

The third <color=#FFFEC1>Jamming Node</color> is down. Connecting to the station… We have a problem. SBN blew the elevator shaft to cut the first level off from the upper floors. You cannot reach the second level by elevator. Return to your shuttle and try to find an airlock wide enough on the <color=#FFFEC1>Server Level</color>.
story.hiv_2_telegraph.dlg.stage1_jane_ja: Second jammer down. One left. You're doing fine.
story.hiv_2_telegraph.dlg.stage2_hive_ca: The transport capsule has entered the airlock. The <color=#FFFEC1>Hellstrom Index</color> is inside. Retrieve it and install it in the station’s control computer.
story.hiv_2_telegraph.dlg.stage2_hive_gr:
SSB has hidden the station access frequencies behind its Engram Control Servers. While they remain active, the Control Computer on the third level stays isolated. Destroy all three servers.

Second task: find a suitable airlock where we can send in the transport capsule carrying the Hellstrom Index.
story.hiv_2_telegraph.dlg.stage2_hive_in: Do not lose it. Your task is to place the Index into the station's control computer.
story.hiv_2_telegraph.dlg.stage2_hive_ne: We are connected to the station. The elevator to the third level is unlocked. Proceed to SBN headquarters. Ally Pally must survive. Do whatever you have to do, but do not let her die.
story.hiv_2_telegraph.dlg.stage2_hive_SE: Local isolation of the frequency array has been breached. All that remains is to place the Hellstrom Index into the station's control computer. Stay sharp—Ally Pally must survive.
story.hiv_2_telegraph.dlg.stage2_sbn_SEC: Magnum, your actions are classified as an attack on the systemic foundation of the NCE. Stand down while this can still be described as a routing error. We offer you full amnesty if you withdraw.

Mercenary, think about what you are doing. You are depriving people of communion with an experience they could not otherwise live through. You cannot rob people of the joy of social media for the sake of some ephemeral higher purpose.
story.hiv_2_telegraph.dlg.stage3_hive_el: <color=#FFFEC1>Ally Pally</color> is dead. Rapid integration of SBN is no longer possible. This outcome is unacceptable. Operation failed.
Visual contact with <color=#FFFEC1>Ally Pally</color> confirmed. She must survive. Do not respond to aggression with lethal force.
story.hiv_2_telegraph.dlg.stage3_hive_ro: <color=#FFFEC1>Roberto Millner</color> detected. His executive functions are important, but not unique. Elimination is permitted.
story.hiv_2_telegraph.dlg.stage3_hive_wi: We are connected. I am seeing through her eyes right now. Would you like a small demonstration?
story.hiv_2_telegraph.dlg.stage3_sbn_ell: A plaything in the hands of forces you cannot even begin to understand. For years, I spoke with the Moon, and it answered me. And now that silver light will dissolve in the endlessly sick eyes of a clone.
story.hiv_2_telegraph.dlg.stage3_sbn_rob: You do not even understand whom you killed. The Herald is dead. Now I am the only voice left on the air.
story.hiv_2_telegraph.dlg.stage3_sbn_win: Evacuation of the operative is authorized. Good work, Magnum.
story.hiv_2_telegraph.dlg.stage3_hive_el: Defibrillation won't help. Ally Pally's brain hasn't been remotely human for a long time, and her cardiac function is regulated by entirely different mechanisms. That is precisely why you were not supposed to let her die.
story.hiv_2_telegraph.dlg.stage3_jane_el:
We still have a chance to save the operative. If the clone makes it to the elevator, we can extract them alive.

This... Hive... They don't exactly give us realistic objectives, do they, boss?
story.hiv_2_telegraph.name: Telegraph
story.hiv_2_telegraph.objective2: Destroy the three Engram Servers and receive the capsule carrying the Hellstrom Index.
story.hiv_2_telegraph.objective3: Place the Hellstrom Index into the control computer. Ally Pally must survive.
story.hiv_2_telegraph.objective4: SBN becomes part of the Hive. Evacuation authorized.

story.hiv_3_awakened.after: Earth has been destroyed. I can't believe this. The Hive, speaking through Molay, is trying to contact us.
story.hiv_3_awakened.briefing:
We'll drop you near the bunker entrance. From there, you go on foot. Scanners show small patrols on the surface and inside the bunker. I wonder what all that air mass overhead feels like to people from the Belt. The objective is simple: enter the bunker, find the Andreev Emitter, descend to the lower level of the geofront, and...

Wait... There's some kind of interference in the Magnum's firmware. We'll sort it out, and I'll get back on comms. Good luck.
story.hiv_3_awakened.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Install the Andreev Emitter into a special device on the lower level of the base.
story.hiv_3_awakened.details:
Details: The Hive has opened a flight window for us down to the surface of Earth. There is an old underground AnCom facility on the Orkney Islands. Beneath the bunker lies the geofront — a system of tunnels deep below the surface. Very deep. The lower section of the geofront contains the device required to launch the final procedure. Activating it requires the Andreev Emitter. The problem is that the Emitter was stored there as well, inside the bunker, as an emergency countermeasure against quasimorphosis. After the facility was seized, access to the vault was lost. The surviving corporations have assembled a joint force under the command of the Unchained Belt and taken the base from AnCom. Now they are holding the facility and trying to prevent the completion of salvation. Your task is to take the Andreev Emitter from the occupiers, deliver it to the lower level of the geofront, and launch the procedure.

Additional Info: Orkney was not chosen by accident. Beneath the archipelago, old tunnels, emergency vaults, and fragments of state-era infrastructure have survived—structures AnCom used long before they revealed their true purpose. The surface of the islands is saturated with traces of ancient rituals, but that is no longer the decisive factor. What matters now is not rituals, but the results of many years of anti-quasimorph research.
story.hiv_3_awakened.dlg.hive_1: We are taking operational control. There are three <color=#FFFEC1>Geofront Masts</color> on the second level. They must be switched into operating mode or the underground elevator will remain locked. The masts locally stabilize the environment beneath the Earth’s crust, making it more or less safe to enter. However, signals from the <color=#FFFEC1>Andreev Emitter</color> are being detected in the <color=#FFFEC1>AnCom Sanctuary</color>. The device is still on site.
story.hiv_3_awakened.dlg.hive_2: There are three <color=#FFFEC1>Geofront Masts</color> on this level. Switch them on, and the elevator to the geofront will begin operating. This level also provides access to the <color=#FFFEC1>AnCom Sanctuary</color>. The signal from the <color=#FFFEC1>Andreev Emitter</color> is coming from there.
story.hiv_3_awakened.dlg.hive_3: The geofront has been stabilized, and the isolation has been lifted. Now the <color=#FFFEC1>Andreev Emitter</color> must be delivered there.
story.hiv_3_awakened.dlg.hive_4: Take the Andreev Emitter from him. He took the device from our safe and kept it on him. How presumptuous—he didn't even know what he was dealing with.
